Predicates:
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Reads(y, x) ::: y reads x.
GainsKnowledge(y, x) ::: y gains knowledge by reading x.
Smarter(y) ::: y becomes smarter.

Premises:
Books contain tons of knowledge.
Reads(harry, walden).
Reads(y, x) → GainsKnowledge(y, x).
GainsKnowledge(y) → Smarter(y).

Conclusion:
ContainsKnowledge(walden).
